entities.name: Zegon
entities.description: A city of the Fallaji Empire on the edge of the Great Desert on Terisiare, not belonging to any Fallaji tribe.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: The empire Zegon became part of.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: The new leader of the Fallaji who brought Mishra to Zegon.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother and artificer, whose mak fawa stood at Zegon; took Ashnod as apprentice.

entities.name: Mak fawa
entities.description: Mishra's dragon engine brought to Zegon's walls.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Zegon's chief artificer, who armed the guards with staves and became Mishra's apprentice.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Mishra's bodyguard, used in Ashnod's demonstration.

entities.name: Great Desert
entities.description: Desert at whose edge Zegon lay.

events.summary: The new Qadir brings Mishra and his mak fawa to Zegon's walls to force submission.
events.quote: brought Mishra and his mak fawa to the walls of Zegon to force them to submit to him

events.summary: Ashnod's staves let the guards keep the dragon engine at bay.
events.quote: had equipped the guards with staves that enabled them to keep the dragon engine at bay

events.summary: Ashnod sneaks into Mishra's camp and demonstrates the staff on Hajar.
events.quote: Ashnod secretly snuck into Mishra's camp at night

events.summary: Mishra takes Ashnod as apprentice on condition Zegon submits; Zegon joins the Fallaji Empire.
events.quote: Mishra agreed to take Ashnod as his apprentice

relations.quote: Mishra agreed to take Ashnod as his apprentice
